title: Apex
description: A coast-to-highlands arcade race. Smooth steering, braking, boost and near-miss rewards. Arrows drive, space boosts. Reach 12 km; checkpoints add time.

rules.do: repeat (32) { spawn(null,{d:'M0 0',x:0,y:0,tags:['road'],layer:-1,data:{n:i}}); spawn(null,{id:'lane'+str(i),d:'M0 0',x:0,y:0,layer:0,fill:'#e2d8bc'}); spawn(null,{id:'curb'+str(i),d:'M0 0',x:0,y:0,layer:0,fill:'#f4d8c1'}) }; repeat (20) spawn(i % 4 == 0 ? 'palm' : 'post',{x:0,y:0,tags:['post'],layer:1,data:{z:floor(i/2)*160,side:i%2==0?-1:1}})

do: let input = clamp(axis('x') + (held('right') ? 1 : 0) - (held('left') ? 1 : 0),-1,1); state.steer += (input-state.steer)*min(1,10*dt); state.pos = clamp(state.pos + state.steer*(0.8+state.speed/250)*dt,-1.22,1.22); self.x = 240+state.pos*222; self.rot = state.steer*0.045

let boosting = held('fire') && state.boost > 1 && !held('brake'); let target = (held('go') ? 240 : 175) - (held('brake') ? 125 : 0) + (boosting ? 90 : 0); if(abs(state.pos)>0.9) target *= 0.5; if(boosting) { state.boost=max(0,state.boost-26*dt) } else { state.boost=min(100,state.boost+8*dt) }

state.crash = max(0,state.crash-dt); if(state.crash>0) target=65; self.opacity=state.crash>0 && floor(time*14)%2==0?0.35:1; state.speed += (target-state.speed)*min(1,(held('brake')?5:1.8)*dt); state.dist += state.speed*dt; state.time -= dt; state.score=floor(state.dist)+state.bonus
let f=get('flame'); f.x=self.x; f.opacity=boosting?0.7+sin(time*50)*0.3:0; let b=get('boostbar'); b.scale=state.boost/100; get('progress').scale=clamp(state.dist/12000,0,1)

state.banner=max(0,state.banner-dt); if(state.dist>state.check*4000 && state.check<3) { state.check+=1; state.time+=15; state.banner=3; state.notice='CHECKPOINT   +15 SECONDS'; sound('hit') }; if(state.time<=0 || state.dist>=12000) { state.time=max(0,state.time); state.over=true; state.banner=999; state.notice=state.dist>=12000?'FINISH LINE   ENTER TO RACE AGAIN':'TIME UP   ENTER TO RETRY'; get('flame').opacity=0 }

let t=self.data.n/32; let u=(self.data.n+1)/32; let y=112+t*t*248; let z=112+u*u*248; let q=(y-112)/206; let v=(z-112)/206; let c=240+state.curve*(1-q)*(1-q); let d=240+state.curve*(1-v)*(1-v); let a=12+q*210; let b=12+v*210; let band=floor(q*28+state.dist/45)%2==0

self.d='M'+str(c-a)+' '+str(y)+'H'+str(c+a)+'L'+str(d+b)+' '+str(z)+'H'+str(d-b)+'Z'; self.fill=band?'#353548':'#303043'; let lane=get('lane'+str(self.data.n)); lane.d='M0 0'; let curb=get('curb'+str(self.data.n)); curb.fill=band?'#f4d8c1':'#d05b62'; curb.d='M'+str(c-a)+' '+str(y)+'H'+str(c-a*0.96)+'L'+str(d-b*0.96)+' '+str(z)+'H'+str(d-b)+'ZM'+str(c+a)+' '+str(y)+'H'+str(c+a*0.96)+'L'+str(d+b*0.96)+' '+str(z)+'H'+str(d+b)+'Z'

rules.do: self.data.z-=state.speed*dt; if(self.data.z < -35) self.data.z+=1600; let k=180/(180+self.data.z); self.x=240+state.curve*(1-k)*(1-k)+self.data.side*(20+222*k); self.y=112+k*206; self.scale=k; self.layer=1+k*7

if(!state.over && state.scene=='race') { state.st-=dt; if(state.st<=0) { let lane=floor(rand(0,3))-1; if(lane==state.lastLane) lane=(lane+2)%3-1; state.lastLane=lane; spawn(['traffic','goldcar','purplecar'][floor(rand(0,3))],{x:240,y:112,scale:0.1,layer:2,tags:['traffic'],data:{z:1450,lane:lane*0.67,v:rand(60,105),passed:false}}); state.st=rand(1.0,1.8)-state.zone*0.12 } }

do: let gap=abs(self.data.lane-state.pos); if(abs(self.data.z)<26 && gap<0.23 && state.crash<=0) { state.crash=1.0; state.time=max(0,state.time-2); state.speed*=0.45; state.banner=1.5; state.notice='CONTACT   -2 SECONDS'; sound('lose'); despawn(self) }

if(alive(self) && self.data.z < -32 && !self.data.passed) { self.data.passed=true; state.passes+=1; state.bonus+=25; if(gap>=0.23 && gap<0.43) { state.near+=1; state.bonus+=100; state.boost=min(100,state.boost+12); state.banner=1.3; state.notice='NEAR MISS   +100'; sound('hit') } }; if(self.data.z < -65 || self.data.z>2000) despawn(self)

rules.do: if(state.over && pressed('start')) goto('race'); let t=get('dash'); if(t) t.text='TIME '+str(ceil(state.time))+'   KMH '+str(floor(state.speed)); t=get('info'); if(t) t.text=['COAST','HIGHLANDS','NIGHT RUN'][state.zone]+'   '+str(floor(state.dist))+'/12000 M   PASS '+str(state.passes); t=get('notice'); if(t) { t.text=state.notice; t.opacity=state.banner>0?1:0 }; t=get('verge'); if(t) t.fill=['#28594b','#756044','#243b4c'][state.zone]
